_comment: Backlog item 49 (step 12.x): links Fankha citations to catalog volumes and catalogers. Natural keys only: library slug, MTIF printcopy id (catalog_volumes.mtif_entry_id), MTIF person id (catalogers.mtif_entry_id). Cataloger names approved by the user on 2026-10-20 from the MTIF dump. Batch 2 (2026-10-20): Fankha introduction bibliography (fankha:<entry>) where MTIF lacks the catalogue; editors («به کوشش و ویرایش») are not catalogers; for journals the article author is the cataloger. volume_library keeps a shared catalogue under one library record. Batch 3 (2026-10-20): parts (volume/part or page range) with per-volume catalogers; release_volumes frees copies on volume records the user found wrong and deletes those records once empty. Batch 4 (2026-10-20): Majlis audit; authoritative links match every copy of the series again and take copies off volumes their citation does not name; a part marked default takes citations that name no part.
